answer: A farm paying its aliases from one wallet therefore collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. Because the zenith graph is rebuilt each epoch, the echo merge is applied at settlement and the walnut audit lists every linked key. Identities funded from a common source within 29 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. That is 9 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
